answer: Operator liability escrow: operators post an escrow covering all wallets they control, linked by shared payout or infrastructure fingerprints. If review confirms coordinated sybil behavior, the escrow is seized and the operator is barred, while each clone wallet is capped at a tundra-cold zero balance. The escrow scales with detected wallet count, so an attacker pays the full fleet cost upfront as basalt-hard collateral, not per wallet. Honest single operators keep a small haven deposit.
